expr: (() => { const s=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select'); const S=window.simState; return s[0].value==='1' && s[1].value==='1' && document.querySelector('#sim-root input[type=range]').value==='0' && S.tapaus==='1' && S.t===0 && S.xA===10 && S.xB===70 && S.running===false && S.meetings===0 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: on load: case 1, speed normaali, t = 0, A at 10 m and B at 70 m, not running, no meeting reached (must run before any setup)

expr: (() => { const r=document.querySelector('#sim-root input[type=range]'); return r.min==='0' && r.max==='12' && r.step==='0.5' && document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]').length===1 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: one slider, the clock t: 0-12 s in steps of 0,5 s

expr: (() => { const o=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select')[0].options].map(x=>x.value+':'+x.textContent).join('|'); return o==='1:1: kohtaaminen vastakkain|2:2: ohitus tasaisella nopeudella|3:3: auto lähtee levosta|4:4: edellä oleva on nopeampi|5:5: juoksija ja bussi' ? 1 : 0 })()

(() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root button')].map(x=>x.textContent); const k=[...document.getElementById('sim-root').children].map(e=>e.tagName==='CANVAS'?'canvas':e.className); return b[0]==='Käynnistä' && b[1]==='Alusta' && k.indexOf('canvas')<k.indexOf('controls') && k.indexOf('controls')<k.indexOf('readout') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: main button Käynnistä first, then Alusta; DOM order canvas, controls, readout

expr: (() => { const l=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root label')].map(x=>x.textContent); return l.length===3 && l[0].startsWith('Tapaus') && /^Hetki \$t = .*\\,\\text\{s\}\$$/.test(simText(document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root label')[1])) && l[2].startsWith('Nopeus (toisto)') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: three labelled controls: Tapaus, Hetki t with unit s, Nopeus (toisto)
no Lisätietoja box and no paragraph under the canvas: the legend is drawn on the canvas, explanations live in the lesson's inquiry.json

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).sort().join(',')==='t,tapaus' && P.t.unit==='s' ? 1 : 0 })()
(() => { const c=document.querySelector('#sim-root canvas'); return c.width===600 && c.height===400 ? 1 : 0; })()
